name: stretchshop-demo-data
description: Import StretchShop demo data into MongoDB

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');for (const f of fs.readdirSync('json').filter(n=>n.endsWith('.json'))) { JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join('json',f),'utf8')); console.log('ok', f); }"
